# tomswallapi_tc_class (Resource)

A traffic-shaping class on a device.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tomswallapi_tc_class" "voip" {
  device    = "fw1"
  interface = "eth0:10"
  mark      = 1
  rate      = "2mbit"
  ceil      = "full"
  priority  = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Owning device.
- `interface` (String) iface:class or iface:parent:class.

### Optional

- `ceil` (String) Maximum rate (e.g. 100mbit, or full).
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `mark` (Number) Firewall mark that classifies traffic into this class.
- `priority` (Number) Class priority; lower first.
- `rate` (String) Guaranteed rate (e.g. 10mbit).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the server-assigned numeric id.
terraform import tomswallapi_tc_class.voip 42
```
